material_findings.scope: New native caller receipt and native-proof acceptance; not the unchanged launcher or Stage 1
material_findings.title: Receipt group checks only its final printf, so an earlier required write failure can be ignored
material_findings.mechanism: The script enables set -u, not errexit, and the receipt brace group contains eleven sequential printf commands without per-command failure propagation; the group's status is the last printf's status, which alone gates mv and the observer-0 downgrade. [Shell setup](../../s4-native-caller-v1/native/s4-r6-native-caller-v1.sh#L24-L25) [Receipt group](../../s4-native-caller-v1/native/s4-r6-native-caller-v1.sh#L143-L155)
material_findings.concrete_counterexample: On an otherwise confirmed launcher-0 path, let the printf carrying ACTUAL_LAUNCHER_EXIT/OBSERVER_RETURN or the identity fields return a write error or short-write failure, then let later writes succeed, for example after concurrent space reclamation following transient ENOSPC; the final semantics printf and mv return 0, so a partial required receipt is published and OBSERVER remains 0. [Affected fields](../../s4-native-caller-v1/native/s4-r6-native-caller-v1.sh#L144-L154) [Unchecked group outcome and return](../../s4-native-caller-v1/native/s4-r6-native-caller-v1.sh#L155-L160)
material_findings.consequence: An actual required publication failure can be reported as a successful observer result, and on a retained-owner path the published receipt can omit identity or classification without the receipt-failure branch running; this conflicts with the ruling's prohibition on ignored publication failure. [Receipt outcome](../../s4-native-caller-v1/native/s4-r6-native-caller-v1.sh#L143-L160) [Recovery ruling](/home/user/workspace/tgp-private-evidence/execution/op88/S4_V6_RECOVERY_RULING.md)
material_findings.introduced_vs_reused: This is in the new multi-command receipt writer, not a rediscovery of the accepted driver's terminal writer, which checks one printf invocation before reporting success. [Prior driver terminal write](../../s4-v61/controls/run-controls-v6.sh#L197-L200) [New receipt writer](../../s4-native-caller-v1/native/s4-r6-native-caller-v1.sh#L143-L155)
material_findings.smallest_correction: Make every required receipt write contribute to the checked publication result, for example by AND-chaining the printf calls and allowing mv only when all succeed, or using one checked write operation; keep raw launcher status distinct and retain the existing nonzero publication outcome/diagnostic semantics.
material_findings.closure_evidence: An additive successor source diff must show that any failed required printf prevents successful publication and cannot leave observer 0; exact-delta independent readback is sufficient for the source correction, with actual receipt evidence collected during the separately granted native proof.
